name: Burgeoning / arsenal-then-hand-same-identity-no-carry
notes: Start with2AP as a valid isolated asset fixture; this does not cover how that extra AP was created. First copy from arsenal pays2/1AP and attacks for6+1=7, leaving defender13 andAP1. Second distinct object of the same card ID from hand pays2/1AP and attacks for printed6 only, leaving defender7 andAP0. No intrinsic bonus carries to another object or becomes a global next-attack effect. Neither attack has go again; Oldhim/Bravo adds no second-attack passive. This is object/origin isolation, not an end-turn expiry claim.
